gatoh.utils.linear_link

linear_link(input_param: float, link_val: float, minimum: float = 0.0, maximum: float = 1.0) → float[source]

Utility function that performs constant linear scaling on an input parameter.

This function is primarily intended to be used as a type of ‘link’ function for ABModel parameters throughout iterations.

Parameters:

  • input_param (float) – The input model parameter that is being scaled.

  • link_val (float) – The constant value by which to increase or decrease the input parameter by.

  • minimum (float, optional) – The minimum valid value that the input parameter may take.

  • maximum (float, optional) – The maximum valid value that the input parameter may take.

Returns:

The input parameter after the link function has been applied.

Return type:

float
